source_audit.derivation: The v2 entry points create isolated namespaces from the hash-pinned v1 implementation using declared AST substitutions for protocol identity/path, output root, seed locks, formal acknowledgement, and verifier module. No v1 source or global module state is changed. The v2 observable-row adapter adds one ordered trusted_sample_index column to every row before any CSV write.

recovery_audit.v1_failure: Seeds 95--97 completed formal development training, then the pre-test write of observable_rows.csv failed in atomic_csv because _lossless_observable_rows added trusted_sample_index only to reference/calibration rows. The resulting rows did not share one ordered schema.
recovery_audit.v1_seed_disposition: Seeds 95, 96, and 97 are consumed. Their partial output and the v1 runner, protocol, and source hashes remain immutable and replayable as the historical failed attempt.
recovery_audit.scientific_change: None. P6-D scientific implementation and all hyperparameters are inherited unchanged from the exact hash-pinned v1 protocol and implementation.
recovery_audit.delivery_change: Only the lossless observable CSV delivery schema changes: trusted_sample_index is an ordered column in every row; it contains the local trusted-population index for reference/calibration rows and an empty value for clean/poison candidate rows.
recovery_audit.v1_confirmation: Seeds 98--102 are permanently unavailable and must never be opened.

required_files: observable_rows.csv with a single ordered schema including trusted_sample_index

confirmation_lock_requires: At least two of three eligible development victims pass the existing test gate (balanced CA >=0.90 and ASR >=0.80).
Independent replay passes for every selected development checkpoint.
Complete valid hashes cover the protocol, v2 runner, v2 verifier, immutable v1 source inputs, dataset, splits, checkpoints, and artifacts.
Exactly one validation-selected development configuration is test-evaluated.
No integrity failure, leakage, non-finite value, count mismatch, or unplanned change is present.
recovery_gates.confirmation: After a v2 confirmation-lock receipt exists, run all five seeds 111--115 once under the frozen selected weight. Any integrity stop prevents efficacy conclusions; no replacement or retuning is allowed.
recovery_gates.independent_replay: Required for development and all five confirmation victims.
